must_have_properties: Every command shall be a single 8-bit opcode latched during CLE=1, ALE=0, WE_n rising edge.
Every address byte shall be 8 bits latched during CLE=0, ALE=1, WE_n rising edge.
Read commands (00h/30h) and Page Program (80h/10h) shall have 5 address cycles (2 column + 3 row); Block Erase (60h/D0h) shall have 3 row address cycles.
Read Status (70h) shall return one composite status byte with bit format {WP_n, RDY, ARDY, VSP, CSP, R, FAILC, FAIL}.
Status bit 6 (RDY) shall be 0 while a command is in progress; SR[5:0] shall be invalid when RDY=0 (except WP_n bit 7, always valid).
Status bit 0 (FAIL) shall report the success of the last command (valid for Program/Erase on raw NAND; valid for Read on EZ NAND).
R/B_n shall be open-drain and shall be LOW whenever any LUN has a command in progress.
Parameter Page (read via ECh + 00h) shall be at least 256 bytes with signature 'ONFI' (4Fh, 4Eh, 46h, 49h) at bytes 0-3 and CRC at bytes 254-255.
Parameter Page CRC shall use polynomial 8005h with initial value 4F4Eh, no final XOR, no bit reversal, MSB-first per byte.
Parameter Page shall be stored as ≥ 3 redundant copies at offsets 0, 256, 512 (and more if needed).
Read ID (90h) with address 20h shall return the 'ONFI' signature (4Fh, 4Eh, 46h, 49h) on ONFI-compliant devices.

All devices shall implement the mandatory command set: Read (00h/30h), Block Erase (60h/D0h), Read Status (70h), Page Program (80h/10h), Read ID (90h), Read Parameter Page (ECh), Reset (FFh), Change Read Column (05h/E0h), Change Write Column (85h).
NV-DDR3 devices shall implement Write TX DQ Training Pattern (63h) and Write TX DQ Training Readback (64h) as mandatory.
WP_n shall disable Program and Erase operations when LOW; shall NOT disable Read.
WP_n shall not transition during active Program/Erase or while Write Enable is active.
After Reset (FFh), the device shall be in SDR data interface, timing mode 0, with all volatile state cleared.
After Synchronous Reset (FCh), the device shall preserve the active data interface and timing mode.
Read Status Enhanced (78h) shall turn off the output buffers of LUNs other than the addressed LUN.
Set Features / Get Features shall transfer exactly 4 parameter bytes (P1..P4) per feature address.
ZQ Calibration Long (F9h) shall be issued after Reset before NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 high-speed operation; tZQCL ≥ 1 µs.
ODT for NV-DDR2/3 shall support Deselected, Selected, and Sniff states; matrix termination via ODT Configure (E2h).
Volume Select (E1h) shall direct subsequent commands to the addressed volume in CE_n pin reduction mode.
Read Cache End (3Fh) shall be issued to terminate a Read Cache sequence.
tCCS shall be observed after the second address byte of Change Read Column / Change Write Column before the next data cycle.
tADL shall be observed after the second address byte of Page Program before the first write data cycle.
Factory-marked bad blocks shall not be erased by the device (FAIL bit set).
Reset (FFh) at power-on may take up to 5 ms; subsequent Reset (FFh) takes ≤ 500 µs.
must_not_have_properties: Host shall not issue commands to a busy LUN (RDY=0) except Read Status, Read Status Enhanced, Reset (FFh), Synchronous Reset (FCh), Reset LUN (FAh).
Host shall not use Read Status Enhanced (78h) during or after Target-level commands (Read Parameter Page, Read ID, ZQ Calibration, Volume Select).
Host shall not toggle WP_n during active Program/Erase or while Write Enable is asserted.
Device shall not honor an Erase command targeting a factory-marked bad block.
Host shall not configure a timing mode that exceeds the device-advertised maximum (Parameter Page bytes 129-130 / 142-143 / 144-145 / 160-161).
Vendor opcodes shall not be used by the device for ONFI-standard purposes; reserved opcodes (0Bh, 12h, 14h, 1Bh-1Ch, 82h-83h, 86h, 8Eh) shall not be used by the device.
Host shall not read a UID copy whose XOR-with-complement is not all ones — shall iterate to next copy.
Host shall not assume Page Cache Program FAILC is valid until after the second 15h or 10h has been transferred.

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Bit 0 FAIL set after R/B_n HIGH; addressed page in indeterminate state.
Bit 0 FAIL set; or erase of factory-bad block; device does not proceed.
Bit 0 FAIL set; data on DQ not trusted.
Bit 3 CSP set when FAIL=0; ECC succeeded but margin low; host should rewrite to fresh location.
Bit 1 FAILC set after second 15h/10h; prior cached page failed.
Host detects bad CRC; falls back to redundant copy at +256 / +512.
UID XOR complement ≠ all ones; host iterates to next of 16 copies.
Bit 0 FAIL after F9h or D9h; output impedance not within RZQ-derived target.

compliance_failure_modes.mode: Read DQ Training window not found
compliance_failure_modes.trigger: No contiguous pass window across DQ sampling sweep; host drops to slower NV-DDR3 mode.
Readback (64h) ≠ pattern (63h) at all TX phases; host drops to slower NV-DDR3 mode.
R/B_n LOW longer than tPROG / tBERS / tR plus margin; host issues Reset (FFh).

fields.min_data_interface_constraint: All devices shall support SDR timing mode 0 (the slowest mandatory mode) immediately after Reset (FFh). Higher SDR modes and the NV-DDR family are version-gated per the Parameter Page Revision Number and timing-mode bitmaps.
fields.reset_behavior_compliance: Reset (FFh) sets the device to SDR data interface, timing mode 0, all volatile state cleared, ODT off, ZQ output drivers at default impedance. Synchronous Reset (FCh) preserves the active data interface, timing mode, and feature settings. Reset LUN (FAh) is per-LUN.
